g.text: Why the gray links matter

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d626a

g.text: They contain no closed loop. Under the gauge constraint,

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d626a

g.text: a physical observable depending only on those links is constant.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d626a

g.text: Each colored group therefore removes the whole centered

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d626a

g.text: conditional mean. The same energy pays for all three checks.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d626a

g.text: This is a cover of variables, not a deformation of physical space.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d626a

g.text: Curves are the proved lower bounds, not measured gaps.
